items.title: Charles Elgar Interview, 1958-05-27
items.q: Since I met him and heard him and saw him in action, I've been trying to get him a date here in Chicago to Grant Park.

ctx.x: Since I met him and heard him and saw him in action, I've been trying to get him a date here in Chicago to Grant Park. I haven't been successful so far. They always have some lame excuse. But the boy has done a grand, grand job.
I was going to ask too about Eddie's South. Is he still playing around here?
